name: ultrafast
description: Make and edit videos as JSON scenes rendered on the local GPU (Metal or Vulkan) with no browser: type, footage, 3D and shaders, frames and contact sheets to look at, a review for clipped or unreadable text, and H.264, HEVC or ProRes export, with no account or API key. Install: `curl -fsSL https://ultrafast.mov/install.sh | sh`, then run `uf mcp` · [Docs](https://github.com/ultrafastmov/ultrafast/blob/main/docs/MCP.md) · Registry: `io.github.ultrafastmov/ultrafast`
